title: Helmetlok Carabiner Helmet Lock
features: Heavy-duty carabiner design for secure helmet attachment
Universal compatibility with most full-face and modular helmets
Durable steel construction resists cutting and weathering
description:
Machined for unyielding stability in high-buffet slipstreams, the Helmetlok Carabiner Helmet Lock from Helmetlok provides dependable hardware security and equipment mounting. Built with Marine-Grade 316 Stainless Steel & CNC Anodized Aluminum (Salt-Spray Resistant), it boasts an installation rating of 0.5 / 10 (Clips directly through helmet D-ring to handlebar or frame).

The Helmetlok Carabiner Helmet Lock delivers robust utility and rock-solid mechanical reliability from Helmetlok, giving riders an uncompromising platform for telemetry, camera capture, or secure helmet stowage.
yoast_metadesc: Complete specs, real-world review, and verified helmet compatibility guide for the Helmetlok Helmetlok Carabiner Helmet Lock.
